sentences.text: Caieiria was a titanosaurian dinosaur discovered in the Late Cretaceous Serra da Galga Formation of Brazil.
Scientific analysis places this animal in a clade at the base of Aeolosaurini within the group Rinconsauria.
Its species name translates to strange tail, highlighting unusual anatomy.
The defining fossil is a specific collection of ten tail bones identified as MCT 1719-R.
This creature lived during the Maastrichtian stage of the Late Cretaceous, between 72.2 and 66 million years ago.
Its environment included other dinosaurs like Ypupiara and crocodylomorphs such as Itasuchus and Peirosaurus.
